result_nature: Infinite-parameter proof and Lean certification, with supplementary finite structural checks
novelty_status: not_claimed; reuses an existing upstream zero-count theorem
independent_review: Pending Host-invoked Reviewer; this script is not independent review

hypotheses.main_modulus: B prime, h=B^k>=2, Smith exponents 0<=b<=e<=k, I=B^(b+e)
hypotheses.auxiliary_modulus: q prime, h^100<q<=2*h^100; intermediate theorem only needs q>=h^26
hypotheses.cap: S in [0,floor(q/(1000*h^4)))^3 with no three distinct collinear points and |S|>=q^2/(2000^3*h^12)
hypotheses.matrices: All box matrices, rows in the row lattice, determinant zero, pairwise distinct projected columns
hypotheses.weight: (q^3/|S|)^3 times the joint inclusion probability under independent uniform G and allowed input shift
hypotheses.N: (h*q)^10; intermediate theorem covers every integer N>=1

server.description: Search and run atomic, composable Jacobian tools for higher mathematics.
server.name: jacobian
server.title: Jacobian Mathematical Workbench

jacobian.metadata_scope: The covolume_rational flag is not used; the checked invariant is the squared covolume.

finite_check_limit: The fixtures are not full-parameter counterexamples or a finite proof of the uniform theorem. The Lean theorem supplies the universal quantifiers.

formal_verification.scope: Full matrix set and actual normalized allowed-shift weight, conditional on the supplied cap and Smith data.
